_evidence: Control objects for menu 0x84e9bb (compose after session_004fd1a0). 0x528927 sets esi = 0x84e9bb and calls 0x53e4db -> 0x53e4e5, which pushes the menu to 0x4fd260: that walk finds the menu in the constant table 0x6698e8 (entry 100 at 0x669d98, list 0x6690d0 of (control id, item key) pairs ending with id 0) and for each item of the menu chain (keys +0xc = 1..0x13) calls 0x5b4da0(id, flag) -> 0x5b79d0. The list holds four ids above 0xffff: 0x30d33 (key 1), 0x10d33 (key 2), 0x10d40 (key 3), 0x20d33 (key 4); for those 0x5b79d0 does 'and eax,0xffff; mov ecx,[eax*4+0xb3d52c]; call 0x5bfbf0' with no null test and 0x5bfbf0 'mov edx,[ecx+0x14c]' faults on a null object. Their low ids 0xd33 and 0xd40 select the slots 0xb3d52c+4*0xd33 = 0xb409f8 and 0xb3d52c+4*0xd40 = 0xb40a2c (both null in the image), so those two slots hold a cobj_005b79d0 object (no child lists: 0x5bfbf0 returns 0, 0x5c0160 returns without writing; +0x30 = 0xb). No low (<= 0xffff) id of this menu (0xd2c, 0xd2f..0xd32, 0xd37..0xd3f) uses either slot, and the game only reaches this walk with the menu's controls created. All other slots keep their image values.
